goal: Replace the flat specialist skill lists with a composed, discoverable, DSH-native skill layer: verified frontmatter, layered core/specialist/capability composition, find-activate-load discovery wired to DSH invalidation, a provider contract reconciled with the merged session-workspace routing fix, and a generated, schema-validated package catalog.

alignment.evidence: Feature branch feature/skill-architecture-v2 rebased onto main 44eb167; Project Harness reusable harness only, no product code and no live DSH session.

Read the DSH skill subsystem doc and source (registry, tool-skill catalogue rendering, filesystem provider frontmatter, ranks, invalidation, watcher) plus PR #6, PR #8, the merged test/dsh-workspace-routing.test.js and the divergent origin/feat/skill-architecture-v2 before reconciling.
00-PLANNING/SKILL-ARCHITECTURE-V2.md models the gap, the composition design, and the reconciliation table mapping each merged PR #8 contract onto this implementation.

Skill layer and adapter only. One bounded write (.harness/state/skills.json on activation). No shell, no Git mutation, no merge, release, deployment or live provider call. The divergent remote branch was left untouched.

DSH owns the registry, layering and catalogue rendering; dsh/skills/*.js owns composition, discovery and workspace resolution; capabilities.json owns the vocabulary; each skill owns its own frontmatter.

Phase one, the mandatory reconciliation with main, and the reviewed merge of the parallel branch's layer vocabulary and catalog validation. Native .dsh/skills migration and new specialists are out of scope; the parallel branch's broader-catalogue composition model was deliberately not merged.

Node built-ins only, no new dependency; bounded walks and reads; path containment on reads and the single write; atomic write; stat-poll instead of a chokidar dependency; stray non-skill entry and duplicate preset filename removed.

Node 22.23.2: 94/94 tests including the four merged PR #8 workspace-routing regression tests with no assertion weakened, the catalog validator, freshness and legacy-alias tests; skills:verify, skills:catalog --check, control:verify, memory:resume and git diff --check passed. Live DSH acceptance remains a separate step.
